notes:
• Added a slider bar for the plugin parameters that have number types with minimum and maximum values. It is enabled by default, but you can disabled it under the Tools > Settings > Plugin Parameters
  • Added the Compact Select Amount setting under Plugin Parameters, with a default value of 3. Select parameters with up to the configured number of options now appear as compact segmented controls.
  • Added a save button to the struct windows. Now you don’t need to close the struct window to save your changes. The keyboard shortcut also works.
  • Added a new option under the File menu: Recent Projects. It will show the last five projects you opened with the app.
  • Now animations ids chosen on the plugin parameters will tell if they are MV or MZ type.
  • Redesigned boolean parameters with segmented buttons, matching the Insert Mode control. Both true and false remain visible alongside custom @on and @off labels when provided.
  • Updated the Insert Mode control so all options have equal widths, determined by the longest option label.
  • Prevented context menus from opening on boolean and compact select controls.
  • Changed how TAB works when on a plugin parameter field. Now, when pressing TAB you will go to the next plugin parameter. Pressing SHIFT + TAB you will return to the previous one.
  • Changed the name of the folder that stores all the app configurations from .hakuen-plugin-manager to .pluginManager
  • Changed the place where the folder `Plugin Parameters Backup` was stored. Instead of it being inside the js folder, now it will be inside the .pluginManager folder.
  • Fixed a visual issue where the parameter input fields and the parameter names are not properly aligned.
  • Fixed an issue that multiline string parameters are not correctly being displayed on the editor when they have more than one line.
  • Fixed the buttons inside the about windows that were not properly getting the style of all other buttons on the app.
  • Fixed an issue with the automatic conflict manager that was not properly understanding when an external change on the plugins parameters was being made.
